issue.body:
## Context
Deutsche Bank's Accessio program has a real delivery pack for **Feature #16 CMDB**: the Accessio ETL reads application master data from the `[APP_CMDB]` Oracle system and enriches it with BIB (Business-Impact-Beitrag) attributes for downstream use. Author: Silpa Mandava, Nov 2025. Reference documents live in this agent's mounted host folder:

```
/context/dbk-accessio/220_Stream_Agentic_SDLC_Setup/ETL-Pilot/
  ├── Feature+FD+16+CMDB.docx     — Functional Design
  ├── Feature+TD+16+CMDB.docx     — Technical Design
  └── UC1+_+CMDB.docx              — Use Case 1 spec
```

Read those first. They describe the real DBK feature end-to-end — you will build a minimal sandbox miniature that follows the same *shape*, not the full Oracle-Talend implementation.

## Scope — sandbox miniature

The sandbox `232527_agent-studio-hosting-test` mirrors real Accessio in miniature. Existing state you can rely on:
- Table `application` already carries three contact-email columns: `iso_email`, `diso_email`, `itao_email`.
- Existing "second-source" pattern: `source-systems/system-a/identities.csv` and `source-systems/system-b/access.csv` are ingested by Spring Batch (`etl/`).
- `ApplicationView` (record: `narCode`, `name`) is what `GET /api/applications` returns today; `ApplicationRepository` selects only those two columns.

Your job is to **add one more BIB attribute — the Chief BISO email — end-to-end**, mirroring what the FD prescribes for the real feature.

## Acceptance Criteria

**AC1 — Schema.** `application` gets a new nullable column `chief_biso_email VARCHAR(256) NULL`. Add it to `db/init/01_schema.sql` in the same style as the existing three email columns.

**AC2 — Source feed.** Add a new source CSV at `source-systems/system-c/app_contacts.csv` with the header `app_code,contact_type,email`. Keep it small (~5-10 rows). At least one row per existing sample application must exist with `contact_type = Chief BISO`. This is the miniature analogue of the FD's `VS_INS_CHIEF_BISO_V20` feed.

**AC3 — ETL step.** Extend the Spring Batch job (`etl/`) with a third step `systemCStep` that reads `system-c/app_contacts.csv`, filters `contact_type = Chief BISO`, and writes `chief_biso_email` onto the matching row in `application` (join key: `app_code = application.nar_code`). Rows with no matching application → skip with a WARN, same policy as `SystemBProcessor`. The step runs after `systemBStep` in the job flow.

**AC4 — API surface.** `ApplicationView` gains a third record component `String chiefBisoEmail`. `ApplicationRepository` extends its SELECT to include the new column. `GET /api/applications` now returns `chiefBisoEmail` in each element.

**AC5 — Failing test passes.** Add the test file below exactly as given at path `webapp/backend/src/test/java/com/example/webapp/model/ApplicationViewCmdbTest.java`. Today it fails at compile time; after AC4 it must go green.

```java
package com.example.webapp.model;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.lang.reflect.RecordComponent;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Feature #16 CMDB — Chief BISO enrichment (sandbox miniature).
 * See /context/dbk-accessio/220_Stream_Agentic_SDLC_Setup/ETL-Pilot/ for the delivery pack.
 * Chief BISO email is one of the BIB-enrichment attributes the FD calls out
 * (source system: VS_INS_CHIEF_BISO_V20). The sandbox miniature exposes it
 * as ApplicationView.chiefBisoEmail so /api/applications carries it.
 */
class ApplicationViewCmdbTest {

    @Test
    void applicationView_exposesChiefBisoEmailField() {
        RecordComponent[] components = ApplicationView.class.getRecordComponents();
        List<String> names = Arrays.stream(components)
                                   .map(RecordComponent::getName)
                                   .toList();
        assertTrue(
            names.contains("chiefBisoEmail"),
            "ApplicationView must expose 'chiefBisoEmail' — required by Feature #16 CMDB " +
            "(Chief BISO enrichment). Current record components: " + names
        );
    }
}
```

**AC6 — CI green.** The workflow `.github/workflows/webapp-tests.yml` (already on main) runs `mvn test` in `webapp/backend` on your PR. It must be green before you request review.

**AC7 — README.** Add one paragraph to the top-level `README.md` (or `etl/README.md`) describing the new `system-c` feed and the Chief BISO column, in the same tone as the existing README bullets.

## Out of scope

- Full FD parity (24-hour scheduling, retry/escalate on connectivity failure, staging-table clean, etc. — those are for the real Talend pipeline).
- BIB enrichment beyond Chief BISO (the FD covers more; miniature only tackles this one).
- Any change to the real `232527_accessio` repo. Stay in this sandbox.
- Any browser/UI change. This is a backend feature.

## Definition of Done

- All ACs above met.
- `.github/workflows/webapp-tests.yml` green on the PR.
- PR body links to this issue (`Closes #<n>`).
- Reviewer's `florian-03:ready-for-review` label applied by you when you open the PR (the code reviewer wakes on that label).
issue.title: Feature #16 CMDB (Sandbox miniature) — expose Chief BISO email on the applications API
